assets.prompt: Eleven 48x64 frames side by side: a crypt gate (an archway of stone blocks with a keystone, two posts with carved runes, a threshold slab in front, a dark opening) opening. The runes light in Void base from the bottom one up, a veil of Void light rises from the threshold row by row until it fills the arch (Void shadow at its sides, Void light in the middle, Bone light motes), then five frames of its motes rising, looping back to the first full frame. Only rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; 1px Outline, light from the top-left.
